highlights: Designated Safeguarding Lead and Child Protection Officers
Vigilant care and protection of all students
Adherence to international data protection law / PDPA
safety.policy_summary: KPIS International School takes Safeguarding and Child Protection seriously, supported by a designated Safeguarding Lead and Child Protection Officers. Staff are dedicated to providing a nurturing, supportive environment where children have the right to be safe and protected from all forms of physical, emotional, and mental harm. The school also adheres to international data protection and privacy regulations (PDPA).
